reuse.why: Extends the existing isWeekendOrHoliday helper that every holiday check (next date, upcoming dates, range dates, budget templates) already routes through.

duplication.why: No logic duplicated; the MM-DD match is a single added clause in the shared predicate.

placement.why: The rule lands in shared/schedules.ts, the shared predicate for holidays.

scope.why: Predicate change, a doc comment on the type, a focused test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Small, commented, single point of change.
